capabilities: Check current note for spelling issues
Apply or ignore suggestions from underlined issues
Optionally check notes automatically as you type
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.8.7+ and internet access. Checks send the note or selection, including Markdown, properties and code, to wsbapp-ku.rast.krd; automatic checking sends the active note as you type and switch notes. Only the setting and a service session ID are saved locally.
problem: Notes written in Kurdish (Sorani) have no built-in spelling or orthography checking in Obsidian.
summary: Spellchecker that underlines Kurdish (Sorani) spelling and orthography issues in notes and selections, with click-or-tap corrections via an external service.
